days.lesson: Art 14: any person (citizen+foreigner). Two limbs: equality before law (Dicey) + equal protection (US). Bans class legislation, allows reasonable classification: (1) intelligible differentia + (2) rational nexus. Royappa 1974 + Maneka 1978: arbitrariness alone violates Art 14. Art 15 citizens only, 5 grounds (religion race caste sex place of birth); 15(2) state-funded access only; 15(3) women/children; 15(4) SC/ST/OBC; 15(5) private colleges ex minority (93rd); 15(6) EWS (103rd). Art 16 citizens, jobs, 7 grounds (+descent residence); residence rule by Parliament only; 16(4)/4A/4B/6 quota. Indra Sawhney 1992: 16(4) is real-equality method not exception, 50% ceiling, creamy layer out. Art 17 absolute punishable. Art 18 no state titles ex military/academic; foreign title needs President. Exceptions: 361 immunity, 359 emergency (20-21 immune post-44th), 31C cut by Minerva Mills 1980 to 39(b)(c).

days.lesson: Art 19(1) six freedoms (citizens): speech, assembly unarmed, association, movement, residence, profession. 19(1)(f) property DELETED by 44th 1978, now Art 300A legal right. Restrictions 19(2)-(6): speech 8 heads (BNS defamation link); assembly public order; association same+morality; movement/residence public+ST; profession qualifications/state monopoly. Art 20: no retrospective crime/penalty (civil ok), no double jeopardy (parallel dept+criminal ok), no self-incrimination. Art 21: Maneka fair-just-reasonable; privacy Puttaswamy 2017; 44th shields 20-21 in emergency (reverses ADM Jabalpur 1976). 21A RTE 6-14 (86th 2002). Art 22: grounds+counsel+24hr magistrate (journey excluded); enemy aliens + preventive detention excluded from 22(1)(2); Board review + representation for detenus. BNSS mirrors 24hr remand; preventive track outside it.

days.lesson: Preamble: Justice social/economic/political; Liberty thought/expression/belief/faith/worship; Equality status/opportunity; Fraternity dignity + unity/integrity. 42nd added Socialist Secular Integrity. Berubari 1960: not part; Kesavananda 1973: part of Constitution, amendable subject to basic structure; 44th-era reaffirmed. Citizenship 5-11: single citizenship; Art 5 cut-off 26 Jan 1950 domicile/birth/descent; Art 6 Pakistan migrants; Art 7 Pakistan-to-India returnees need permit; Art 8 Indians abroad via registration; Art 9 no dual; Art 10 continuance subject to Parliament law; Art 11 Parliament power (Citizenship Act 1955 + CAA 2019). Art 12 State definition (govt+parliament+local+authorities; BCCI not State per Zee Telefilms). Art 13: pre-constitutional void to inconsistency; post laws abridging FR void; 24th: constitutional amendments NOT Art 13 law (Golaknath reversed).

days.lesson: President Art 52-62: elected by MPs+MLAs (nominated excluded), 5 yrs, oath CJI, 35 yrs + LS qualified. Powers: executive 53, assent 111 (assent/withhold/return once; pocket veto US-convention), ordinance 123 (6 weeks), pardon 72 (consultation + Epuru Sudhakar review for mala fide). VP Art 63-71: RS Chairman ex-officio, no casting first; vacancy acting President. Governor Art 153-167: appointed, pleasure, 35 yrs; assent 200 (options + reservation for President); ordinance 213; report 356; noPocket? same return once. 91st 2003: CoM max 15% of House (Art 75/164), disqualified defector barred. LAW: pardons intersect BNS sentencing; ordinances vs BNSS procedures need re-promulgation limits (D.C. Wadhwa). AP: Governor assent/reservation episodes asked as current-polity link.
